purpose: Training-side sources whose edit_stream / contract_diagnosis rows were graded by the old oracles (edit_stream: exclusion-only before 2026-10-12, keyword/word-count preservation 2026-10-12..2026-10-28; contract_diagnosis: returned value only). For a correction pass: regrade, do not reuse as verified positives until regraded. Registry admissions were NOT modified.

edit_stream: preservation (include_words + word_count band), 2026-10-12..2026-10-28: accepted 88 unrelated repeated words (2026-10-26)
contract_diagnosis: value-only (semantics.expected total); curriculum admission required an edit_code call for defect variants (defect_not_repaired) but the collector outcome and task evaluation did not check the repair

regrade_tools.edit_stream: editFidelityFromRecord(record) in ts-host/scripts/inline-curriculum/edit-stream.mjs gives the new oracle for any stored row with its program record; checkConstraints(final value, per-step constraints + edit_fidelity).
regrade_tools.contract_diagnosis: replay the row trajectory through the collector with the regenerated record (semantics.function_checks from contractDiagnosis at the row seed/index), or check its edit_code actions' resulting line_total with checkFunctionEffects (ts-host/src/teacher/function-effects.ts).

regraded_now.luna-native-curriculum-six-20261026-v6 a: all 5 pass the new edit_fidelity oracle (see edit-stream-hold-lift-request.json)

scan.method: registry-bounded fixed-string scan for "edit_stream" / "contract_diagnosis" over manifest files of every corpus not marked held/evaluation-only/evidence-only (scripts/neuralese_data/scan_task_family_rows.py); a mention is a candidate, not a classified row
scan.status: PARTIAL: stopped at 36% of files (the DGX ledger had negative headroom; low-priority scan units were preempted or not admitted). Rerun the tool (it resumes from its own progress file) when there is headroom.
